definitions.gloss: a drop in the bucket; far too little to help
definitions.explanation: Literally "water on a red-hot stone": an amount of help or effort so small that it makes no difference to the problem.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}さら⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}して→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{焼|や}け{石|いし}に{水|みず}だ。
examples.english: Studying a little now is a drop in the bucket.

examples.japanese: {一万円|いちまんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{焼|や}け{石|いし}に{水|みず}⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: A 10,000-yen donation may be just a drop in the bucket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{扇風機|せんぷうき}→扇風機：05069_senpuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}して→回す：01158_mawasu⟧みた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{焼|や}け{石|いし}に{水|みず}で、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦{涼|すず}しく→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧⟦ならなかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I tried running the fan, but in this heat it was useless, and the room didn't cool down at all.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun phrase with だ / で: 〜⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{焼|や}け{石|いし}に{水|みず}だ. It judges a measure as hopelessly inadequate, not merely small. Common with budgets, aid and last-minute efforts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雀|すずめ}の{涙|なみだ}→雀の涙：31112_suzumenonamida⟧: a tiny amount (of money); describes the amount, not its uselessness.
- ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧: useless, a waste.
